column3: The glory of His grace is rendered as “His glorious grace.”
The final in Him is not repeated.
Being allotted is rendered as being “chosen as God’s own.”
The second in whom is not repeated; Spirit of promise is rendered as “promised Holy Spirit.”
The acquired possession is specified as those belonging to God.
Father of glory is rendered as “glorious Father.”
“These are” supplies a new clause for according to the working.
“God” supplies the subject; giving Him as head is rendered as making Him head.
